meta.description: Test crypto wallet on Circle Developer-Controlled Wallets (Base Sepolia)

home.selectUserText: Create a user or pick an existing one in the top right corner. Each user has their own Circle wallet and deposit address.

wallet.syncHint: Pull transactions from Circle without waiting for a webhook
wallet.synced: Synced with Circle: {count, plural, =0 {no new transactions} one {# transaction processed} other {# transactions processed}}
wallet.empty: Nothing here yet. Click “Deposit” to get the address and test USDC.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.intro: Send test tokens to the wallet address of {name} on {blockchain}. The deposit will show up in the history automatically.
deposit.step2: Open the Circle faucet, choose USDC and the Base Sepolia network. Check the network: if the faucet suggests another one by default (e.g. Arc Testnet), the tokens go there and never arrive here.
deposit.step3: Paste the address and submit. Faucet limit: one request per 2 hours per address and token.
deposit.receivedPending: +{amount} {symbol} — waiting for network confirmation, then the amount becomes available.
deposit.waiting: Waiting for the incoming transfer. It usually shows up a few seconds after it lands on-chain (Circle webhook) or within 30 seconds (Circle polling).

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.errorPositive: Amount must be greater than zero
withdraw.sentMessage: {amount} {symbol} — see the status in the history

errors.network_error: Backend is unreachable. Make sure it is running.
errors.circle_error: Circle is unavailable or returned an error
errors.idempotency_key_reused: This withdrawal request was already sent with different parameters. Submit again.
